sourceReferencePolicy: city-a and accepted farm tree-oak-card-a, bush-card-a, flower-card-c were inspected visually. New-generation calls omit referenced image paths; style cues are described in each prompt.

toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a finished isolated transparent plant sprite for a warm colourful mobile town game, not a scene or photograph.
Style: painterly toy-town art with rounded soft volumes, many small rounded oval leaves grouped into soft green lobes, gentle highlights, warm yellow-green lit areas and natural deep green shading. Match cheerful cream-and-colour town buildings and the hand-painted leafy oak/bush sprite family. No black outlines, photoreal noise or plastic gloss.
Camera: orthographic three-quarter game view from above, approximately52 degrees elevation, showing top and front surfaces; not a flat side elevation and not straight top-down.
Light: soft diffuse sunlight from scene lower-left/southwest; softly modelled foliage only. Absolutely no cast shadow, ambient shadow puddle, ground contact shadow or baked backdrop.
Composition: one complete plant asset, centred with its ground-contact base horizontally centred near the bottom. All leaves and tips fully inside the square with a small transparent margin; no clipping. Natural visible silhouette and genuine transparent alpha around and between foliage gaps, not a checkerboard, solid background or colour key.
No ground plane, earth disk, turf mat, pot, planter, stone edging, surrounding scenery, detached floating leaves, text, logo, watermark or frame. No extra objects.

Subject: One compact urban deciduous tree with a large nearly spherical crown of five or six softly overlapping rounded leaf masses and a short visible warm brown trunk. Balanced full rounded canopy, cheerful bright fresh green. The trunk has a subtle fork visible just below the crown, its base centred. Neat park/street tree, not a wild sprawling oak, no fruit or flowers.
Produce one square finished sprite, requested resolution1024x1024, with actual transparent background.
